messages:
elaine: Quick RFC follow-up: we need a lightweight plan to move control-plane traffic for some tenants from central CP to tenant-local CPs without changing customer endpoints. keeping downtime ~0.
sung: outline? main risks are cert bootstrap, cross-VPC streaming, and routing drift.
elaine: phases: bootstrap & certs, read-shadowing, non-blocking writes + reconciliation, canary ramp, cutover.
nate: certs: generate key locally, CSR -> central signer over privatelink/peering. token exchange. ensure key never leaves tenant.
elaine: agree. also propose tiering: small tenants use peering; enterprise/regulatory use PrivateLink. document cost & route-table impacts.
sung: telemetry: ship aggregates centrally, keep full traces local unless customer opts-in. add cache-warmup probe.
devops-bot: deploy:cp-bootstrap started for tenant delta-21 at 3491122350 by elaine
elaine: ops checklist: pre-create rollback cluster, verify DNS TTLs before flip, billing check after each ramp step. will post RFC follow-up with diagrams.
